svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":4,"chapter":"Ch.4 · The Scroll","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Baruch writes Jeremiah's words on a scroll; the king cuts it with a knife and burns it, column by column, and it is written again.
